rationale: No existing spec covers the save-a-builder-chart-as-a-saved-view-then-restore-it path. logsVisualizePersistence covers tab persistence and URL-based Visualize/Build refresh (not saved-view buildData restore); logsQueryBuilder-chart covers chart auto-selection from SQL (not saved-view restore); monaco-query-prefill and logsqueries cover saved-view create/apply for SQL query prefill only; logsBuildStreamList covers build-tab stream selection. The savedBuildConfig hand-off (SearchBar.applySavedView -> BuildQueryPage.initializeFromQuery) is entirely new coverage, so a new spec is required. It must be registered in the Logs-Features shard of ci_matrix.json.
